messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Alert: p99 latency and increased 5xx rate for /v1/generate (redwood-13B-serving) in us-east-1. Started 1715009900. Paging oncall.

santiago_oncall: on it. looking at the dashboard now.

emily_sre: i see a spike in p95 -> p99 around 15m ago, coincides with canary rollout.

santiago_oncall: timeline? which rollout completed?

emily_sre: canary id c-2026-03-17-03 finished at 1715009000, started ~1715008200.

lina_prodops: logs show many upstream TIMEOUT -> gateway 504s. sample from edge:```
[2026-03-17T03:03:12Z] GET /v1/generate 504 upstream_timeout model-redwood-13B-serving pool=us-east-1
[2026-03-17T03:03:12Z] 5xx_rate=0.12 p99=3.4s
```

santiago_oncall: ok that's consistent. any customer-facing errors? zoe_support?

zoe_support: support dashboard shows a small cluster of errors impacting a handful of customers on dedicated seats — flagged 4 tickets, one escalated to priority. No broad page yet but customers noticing latency. I'm drafting an update.

nate_backend: checking model host metrics — open connections and kvcache miss rate jumped after canary. looks like the canary introduced slightly different attention kernel causing KV cache miss amplification.

emily_sre: hypothesizing: kernel change -> higher mem churn -> longer tail Kv fetch -> request stalls -> gateway timeouts.

santiago_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) abort/rollback canary 2) enable fallback routing to previous model variant 3) throttle new requests to reduce pressure. any objections?

lina_prodops: agree. prepare rollback. deploy-bot, can you trigger a rollback of canary c-2026-03-17-03 to stable? need minimum disruption.

deploy-bot: Rolling back canary c-2026-03-17-03 -> stable v2026-03-10-02. Initiating stepdown, target groups: us-east-1 primary canary. ETA ~3m. /deploy status: in_progress

emily_sre: while rollback runs, enable circuit-breaker for /v1/generate to return 429 early for long running KV stalls (soft-fail) — will update routing rules to prefer redwood-13B-serving-vprev.

santiago_oncall: liaise with traffic team to route 30% to fallback for 5m then 100% if rollback fails. lina, nate please coordinate.

nate_backend: starting a hotfix flag to prefer old kernel:```bash
# temp flag
redwoodctl set-host-attr --model redwood-13B-serving --kernel legacy --scope canary,edge
```

lina_prodops: traffic rule updated to route overflow to vprev. mapping applied.

deploy-bot: rollback completed on canary hosts in us-east-1 at 1715010120. Verification checks running (smoke invocation x10).

emily_sre: smoke invocations green. metrics show p99 dropping back to baseline ~0.35s over last 60s. 5xx rate down to 1.6%.

zoe_support: customer-impact update: sent initial note to 4 customers; will follow up confirming mitigation and next steps.

santiago_oncall: good. keep monitoring 15m. we should also capture a post-incident note: root cause suspected kernel memory churn causing KV cache miss storm after deploy.

nate_backend: captured heap profiles from a few hosts and KV miss histograms; saving to /nfs/incidents/1715009999/ for postmortem.

emily_sre: action items being created: 1) revert kernel change in model onboarding branch 2) add canary perf test that stresses KV cache 3) automations to circuit-break on rising kv_miss_rate.

lina_prodops: i'll create Dedicated Customer comms draft for affected customers and attach metrics.

santiago_oncall: handoff plan: i'll stay on for another 20m to watch for regressions. if stable, i'll file INCIDENT-1715009999 and hand off to emily for postmortem. emily, are you ok picking this up?

emily_sre: yep, i'll take postmortem. please include logs, deploy diff, smoke results, and customer ticket IDs.

zoe_support: ticket updates queued, will send follow-up once 30m of stability confirmed.

deploy-bot: note: canary rollback triggered by santiago_oncall at 1715010000; rollback-id r-2026-03-17-001.

santiago_oncall: final checks: any lingering 5xx from other regions? lina?

lina_prodops: eu-west and ap-south show no correlated spike; isolated to us-east canary cluster.

emily_sre: marking incident as mitigated for now. we should schedule a guarded rollout of the kernel change with KV stress harness.

santiago_oncall: handing off to emily_sre for postmortem and long-running actions. short summary for handoff channel: "mitigated: rolled back canary c-2026-03-17-03 after p99/timeouts spike; suspected kernel -> kv miss amplification; affected subset of customers in us-east; follow-up: perf tests + canary hardening + customer comms."

emily_sre: received handoff. creating the incident doc and assigning owners. thanks all. :thumbsup:

zoe_support: leaving a note in the support board with mitigation and next customer update ETA +30m.

santiago_oncall: ack. closing paging loop.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (auto) — duration 0:08:20. ID INCIDENT-1715009999. Metrics snapshot attached.

emily_sre: i'll ping product and model-onboarding with recommended gating checks before next kernel rollout.

nate_backend: saving debug traces and will attach to the PM.

lina_prodops: handing off ops follow-up to emily_sre. next oncall: emily_sre (primary), santiago_oncall (backup).

emily_sre: thanks — will own the postmortem and follow-ups.
